title: Sevin's Spell Emporium
description: A witch in a dark blue starry robe and pointed hat stands outside her magical shop at night, holding a glowing orb in one hand and raising the other. A black and white cat sits beside an open chest of potion bottles on the cobblestone street, surrounded by scattered scrolls and festive decorations under a starry sky.
prompt: A whimsical fantasy scene at night showing a female witch wearing a long dark blue robe with golden stars and a pointed hat, standing on the steps of her shop named Sevin's Spell Emporium. She holds a glowing orb in one hand while casting a spell. A black and white cat sits nearby next to an open wooden chest filled with potion bottles. The shop has blue wooden doors, a striped awning, hanging magical ornaments, and warm glowing lights inside. Cobblestone street with scattered scrolls and gifts, starry night sky with bright stars above, festive and enchanting atmosphere.
